aliases: The 4 MP (2560×1440) IP camera TR-D4S5 v3 2.8 is designed for outdoor use in any weather conditions, subjected to direct exposure to precipitation. The camera's housing is protected from dust and moisture according to IP66 standards, and it has an extended operating temperature range from -40°C to +60°C. Additionally, it features TVS 4000 V surge protection and IR illumination with a range of up to 25 meters.
